fieldDescription: Incoming sheild damage spikes and a color-reactive EHP ring that respond to incoming fire in real time.
Draws a sleek movement direction arrow at the outer edge of the EHP ring. Helps track inertia and drift in combat.
Vanilla Green and Vanilla Blue match the Starsector HUD palette. Custom activates the color picker below. Applies to both indicators.
Active when Color Preset is set to Custom.
Opacity of all indicators.
Scale factor for ring and spike radius.

Show indicators even when the HUD is hidden (observation mode).
When overloaded: all HUD fades to screen static noise, audio is muffled via low-pass filter. Vanilla HUD is also hidden (the F11 toggle). Immersive but disorienting. Fleet map stays usable.

Controls the vanilla combat killfeed/message log (top-left area). 'Vanilla' = no changes. 'Cap 10 lines' = trim to 10 most recent. 'Hidden' = fully empty. Applies to all messages including Combat Chatter dialogue and pause lines.

defaultValue: Draws a simple ring or corner brackets around your ship. Its sole purpose is to visually distinguish your ship from all others in the heat of battle. No damage reaction or directional information. Legacy.

fieldDescription: Draws a visible marker around your currently piloted ship.
Ring / Pulsing Ring: circle outline (static or animated). Corner Brackets / Pulsing Brackets: L-shaped marks aligned to ship facing.
Draws a thicker overlay version of weapon firing arcs.
Vanilla presets match the Starsector HUD palette. Custom activates the color picker below.
Active when Color Preset is set to Custom.
Line thickness in pixels.
Opacity of arc edge and curve lines.
Opacity of the current weapon facing line.
Hold = show while key pressed. Toggle = press once to turn on/off. Press the keybind below to toggle.
Press this button in the LunaLib settings menu, then press the key you want to use. Default = B (48). Set to 0 to disable keybind.
Show small tick marks at regular distance intervals along each arc to help gauge weapon range.
Distance between range ticks (su).
When half or more weapons in the selected group are disabled the arc lines turn orange and the overlay flickers with screen-tearing offsets. Hidden and decorative weapons are excluded from the count.

defaultValue: Screen-edge bar and rotating ship pointer. The bar slides along the screen perimeter toward the player ship. The ship pointer appears near screen center (offset) only when the ship is off-screen and rotates to point at it.
